object.name: GiftInfo
object.description: Describes a service message about a regular gift that was sent or received.
object.html_description: Describes a service message about a regular gift that was sent or received.
object.rst_description: Describes a service message about a regular gift that was sent or received.

annotations.name: owned_gift_id
annotations.description: Optional. Unique identifier of the received gift for the bot; only present for gifts received on behalf of business accounts
annotations.html_description: Optional. Unique identifier of the received gift for the bot; only present for gifts received on behalf of business accounts
annotations.rst_description: *Optional*. Unique identifier of the received gift for the bot; only present for gifts received on behalf of business accounts

annotations.name: convert_star_count
annotations.description: Optional. Number of Telegram Stars that can be claimed by the receiver by converting the gift; omitted if conversion to Telegram Stars is impossible
annotations.html_description: Optional. Number of Telegram Stars that can be claimed by the receiver by converting the gift; omitted if conversion to Telegram Stars is impossible
annotations.rst_description: *Optional*. Number of Telegram Stars that can be claimed by the receiver by converting the gift; omitted if conversion to Telegram Stars is impossible

annotations.name: prepaid_upgrade_star_count
annotations.description: Optional. Number of Telegram Stars that were prepaid for the ability to upgrade the gift
annotations.html_description: Optional. Number of Telegram Stars that were prepaid for the ability to upgrade the gift
annotations.rst_description: *Optional*. Number of Telegram Stars that were prepaid for the ability to upgrade the gift

annotations.name: is_upgrade_separate
annotations.description: Optional. True, if the gift's upgrade was purchased after the gift was sent
annotations.html_description: Optional. True, if the gift's upgrade was purchased after the gift was sent
annotations.rst_description: *Optional*. :code:`True`, if the gift's upgrade was purchased after the gift was sent

annotations.name: can_be_upgraded
annotations.description: Optional. True, if the gift can be upgraded to a unique gift
annotations.html_description: Optional. True, if the gift can be upgraded to a unique gift
annotations.rst_description: *Optional*. :code:`True`, if the gift can be upgraded to a unique gift

annotations.name: text
annotations.description: Optional. Text of the message that was added to the gift
annotations.html_description: Optional. Text of the message that was added to the gift
annotations.rst_description: *Optional*. Text of the message that was added to the gift

annotations.name: entities
annotations.description: Optional. Special entities that appear in the text
annotations.html_description: Optional. Special entities that appear in the text
annotations.rst_description: *Optional*. Special entities that appear in the text

annotations.name: is_private
annotations.description: Optional. True, if the sender and gift text are shown only to the gift receiver; otherwise, everyone will be able to see them
annotations.html_description: Optional. True, if the sender and gift text are shown only to the gift receiver; otherwise, everyone will be able to see them
annotations.rst_description: *Optional*. :code:`True`, if the sender and gift text are shown only to the gift receiver; otherwise, everyone will be able to see them

annotations.name: unique_gift_number
annotations.description: Optional. Unique number reserved for this gift when upgraded. See the number field in UniqueGift.
annotations.html_description: Optional. Unique number reserved for this gift when upgraded. See the number field in UniqueGift.
annotations.rst_description: *Optional*. Unique number reserved for this gift when upgraded. See the *number* field in :class:`litegram.types.unique_gift.UniqueGift`.
